name: Craftsman's Writ - Rugged Armor Kit
label: Quest
description: Craftsman's Writ - Rugged Armor Kit: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.
All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The rugged armor kits have many uses, friend. They aren't JUST for slapping on certain armor pieces for added protection. Like this one here, I'm going to use it as teapot cozy.
